name: Pebble-Form Wireless Earbuds and Charging Case
description: A pair of stemless bean-shaped wireless earbuds in matte pale-stone grey, each with a small glossy charcoal touch disc on its outer face and a pale silicone ear tip, seated in a smooth pebble-form charging case moulded in the same matte pale-stone soft-touch polymer with a single fine parting line and a shallow thumb notch at the front edge.
subcategory: wireless earbuds with pebble-form charging case
materials: matte pale-stone grey soft-touch polymer case and bud bodies, glossy charcoal touch discs, pale silicone ear tips, gold-tone charging contacts in the moulded wells
primaryColors: pale stone grey, charcoal touch discs, gold-tone contacts
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printing anywhere on the case lid, case body, bud housings, or touch discs; never render a third bud, a stem hanging from either bud, an extra well, a second status light, a visible hinge barrel proud of the shell, or an asymmetric pair, and never lose the single fine parting line where the lid meets the body; never swap the matte pale-stone soft-touch polymer for glossy plastic, metal, or a dark colourway, and never render the case as a square or rectangular box rather than a smooth pebble Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: the smooth seamless pebble silhouette of the charging case, its matte pale-stone soft-touch finish, the single fine parting line where the lid meets the body, the shallow thumb notch centred at the front edge, exactly two identical stemless bean-shaped buds each with one glossy charcoal touch disc and one pale silicone ear tip, two moulded wells each carrying two small gold-tone charging contacts, one small round status light centred on the front face and one USB-C port centred on the rear face, and otherwise completely plain unmarked surfaces must read identically in every angle, same case proportions, bud size and well spacing throughout When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
